_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): the complete admin CRUD page — search, pagination, sorting, create/edit modal, delete confirm, bulk delete, toasts. Composes the sibling L4 components via uses (table, form, modal, toast, http-client all land in the same components_dir). Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-crud-page
description: Complete admin CRUD page: search, pagination, sorting, create/edit modal, delete confirm, bulk delete. Wires table+form+modal+toast together.

variables.name: components_dir
variables.description: Frontend components directory (all composed siblings land here too)

notes: Backend contract (see feature-crud): GET {apiPath}?page=&page_size=&search=&sort=field:dir -> {items,total,page,page_size}; POST 201; PUT 200; DELETE 204. Usage: <CrudPage resource='User' apiPath='/api/users' columns={[{key:'name',label:'Name',sortable:true}]} fields={[{name:'name',label:'Name',rules:{required:'Name is required'}},{name:'role',label:'Role',type:'select',options:[{value:'user',label:'User'},{value:'admin',label:'Admin'}]}]} selectable exportPath='/api/users/export' />. Wrap the app in <ToastProvider> (comp-toast). Requires react-hook-form (npm install react-hook-form) — see comp-form. The Export button calls the feature-export endpoint honoring current search/sort. Wrap in ErrorBoundary for crash safety.
